args.title: Tamarack 2026 Warehouse Automation — Combined Summary
args.body:
• Pick rates rose 18% with the adoption of autonomous carts (main article: blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse).
• Integration took twice as long as planned, a key implementation risk to factor into any rollout timeline.
• The biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks (companion piece: insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion).
